name: Scalp Electroencephalography (EEG; P300 / SSVEP / Motor Imagery)
measured_itr_bps_or_bw: 0.2 to 2.5 bit/s (up to ~5 bit/s in visual SSVEP spellers)
key_limitation: Skull volume-conduction smearing low SNR and muscle/blink artifacts
primary_citation: Wolpaw et al. 2002 Clin. Neurophysiol. (PMID:12048038; doi:10.1016/S1388-2457(02)00057-3)

name: Wearable Optically Pumped Magnetoencephalography (OPM-MEG)
key_limitation: Requires magnetically shielded room/active nulling coils and high sensor cost

name: Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy (fNIRS)
key_limitation: Hemodynamic BOLD-like lag (~2-5 s) and shallow ~1.5-2 cm cortical penetration

name: Transcranial Direct / Alternating Current Stimulation (tDCS / tACS)
key_limitation: Diffuse shunting through scalp (~70-80% current loss) unable to address single columns

name: Transcranial Focused Ultrasound Neuromodulation (tFUS)
agency_gate: External acoustic targeting & duty-cycle safety interlock
key_limitation: Skull acoustic aberration/attenuation requiring CT/MR phase correction and thermal limits
primary_citation: Legon et al. 2014 Nat. Neurosci. (PMID:24413698; doi:10.1038/nn.3620)

name: Endovascular Stent-Electrode Array (Stentrode / SWITCH)
clinical_stage: Human feasibility / pivotal IDE trials (SWITCH n=4)
key_limitation: Limited vessel-wall proximity and 16-channel ceiling vs subdural/intracortical grids
primary_citation: Mitchell Oxley et al. 2023 JAMA Neurol. (PMID:36622685; doi:10.1001/jamaneurol.2022.4847)

name: High-Density Subdural / Epidural Electrocorticography (ECoG Speech BCI)
measured_itr_bps_or_bw: ~18 to 19 bit/s (78 words/min with 253-ch grid + LM)
agency_gate: Attempted-speech onset detector + user stop cue
key_limitation: Lacks single-neuron spike isolation; relies on language-model prior for fluent word completion

name: Intracortical Microelectrode Array Readout (Utah Array Speech / Handwriting)
clinical_stage: Human investigational BrainGate trials (>30 participants cumulative)
key_limitation: Chronic glial encapsulation micromotion impedance drift and transcutaneous/implant footprint
primary_citation: Willett et al. 2021 Nature (PMID:33981047); Willett et al. 2023 Nature (PMID:37612500)

name: Bidirectional Intracortical Sensorimotor BCI (M1 Read + S1 ICMS Write)
measured_itr_bps_or_bw: Read ~5-10 bit/s + Write ~4-8 tactile channels (grasp time halved ~20.9s -> ~10.2s)
agency_gate: Charge-density hardware limit + user motor-grasp coupling
key_limitation: Stimulation artifacts blanking simultaneous recording and non-naturalistic paresthesia/pressure percepts
primary_citation: Flesher et al. 2016 Sci. Transl. Med. (PMID:27738096); Flesher et al. 2021 Science (PMID:34016775)

name: Flexible Polymer Multi-Thread Intracortical Array (Robotic Sewing)
agency_gate: User intention threshold & wireless packet encryption
key_limitation: Thread retraction/displacement post-implantation and unverified multi-year chronic single-unit stability
primary_citation: Musk & Neuralink 2019 J. Med. Internet Res. (PMID:31642810; doi:10.2196/16194)

name: Genetically Targeted Optogenetics (ChR2 / Opsins + Two-Photon)
measured_itr_bps_or_bw: 10 to >100 bit/s cell-type-specific ensemble control in rodents
agency_gate: Promoter cell-type specificity + external laser gate
clinical_stage: Preclinical animal work; early human retinal gene therapy only
key_limitation: Requires exogenous viral opsin expression and invasive light delivery across scattering human cortex
primary_citation: Boyden et al. 2005 Nat. Neurosci. (PMID:16116447; doi:10.1038/nn1525)

name: Closed-Loop Adaptive Deep Brain Stimulation (aDBS; STN + Cortical Sensing)
measured_itr_bps_or_bw: 1-2 D symptom-state control loop (reduces motor symptoms & dyskinesia vs cDBS)
agency_gate: Neural beta/gamma biomarker threshold + patient handheld override
clinical_stage: Blinded randomized human crossover trials (Parkinson's disease)
key_limitation: Low-dimensional symptom biomarker control rather than semantic information transfer
primary_citation: Oehrn et al. 2024 Nat. Med. (PMID:39160351); Shanechi 2019 Nat. Neurosci. (PMID:31551595)

name: Cochlear Auditory Neuroprosthesis (CIS Multi-Channel Array)
measured_itr_bps_or_bw: ~20 to 40 bit/s intelligible open-set speech reception in quiet
agency_gate: External removable speech processor & volume gate
clinical_stage: FDA-approved standard of care (>10^6 recipients globally)
key_limitation: Current spread in perilymph limiting independent spectral channels (~8 effective channels in noise)

name: Epiretinal / Subretinal Visual Prosthesis (Argus II / PRIMA)
measured_itr_bps_or_bw: ~1 to 5 bit/s coarse spatial letter/grating recognition
agency_gate: External camera glasses on/off & gaze alignment
key_limitation: Low pixel resolution axonal streak distortion and hardware lifecycle/support discontinuation risks

name: Rodent Intracortical Brain-to-Brain Interface (M1/S1 ICMS Dyads)
invasiveness: Invasive penetrating microarrays in both subjects
measured_itr_bps_or_bw: ~0.1 to 0.5 bit/s binary tactile/lever task sharing (~64-72% accuracy)
agency_gate: Task-reward conditioning only (no explicit cognitive consent gate)
key_limitation: Strictly 1-bit task-conditioned cue transfer; conflates operant conditioning with general semantic sharing
primary_citation: Pais-Vieira et al. 2013 Sci. Rep. (PMID:23448946; doi:10.1038/srep01319)

name: Human Non-Invasive 3-Person BrainNet (EEG Read -> TCP/IP -> Occipital TMS Write)
measured_itr_bps_or_bw: ~0.02 to 0.08 bit/s (1 bit per multi-second trial; 81.25% accuracy)
agency_gate: Conscious phosphene yes/no interpretation & sender reliability weighting
key_limitation: Ultra-low bitrate (~3 orders of magnitude below speech) mediated entirely by binary visual phosphenes
primary_citation: Rao et al. 2014 PLOS ONE (PMID:25372285); Jiang et al. 2019 Sci. Rep. (PMID:30992474)

name: Intranasal Stem-Cell Extracellular Vesicle Paracrine Supplementation
agency_gate: Dosing regimen cessation & endogenous endocytic receptor uptake
clinical_stage: Preclinical rodent/porcine efficacy; early Phase I safety only
key_limitation: Batch-to-batch cargo heterogeneity rapid peripheral clearance and zero Phase III human neurocognitive proof
primary_citation: Perets et al. 2020 Mol. Autism (PMID:32807217); Losurdo et al. 2020 Stem Cells Transl. Med. (PMID:32496649)

name: Predicted Agency-Preserving N-Mind Bidirectional BCI Mesh
measured_itr_bps_or_bw: Target >39 bit/s semantic/latent exchange per participant
agency_gate: Cryptographic attestation + local opt-in invariant gate g_i(s_i m) = 1 (Lean T29-T31)
key_limitation: Unsolved representational alignment across distinct brains chronic write-safety and authorship/privacy governance
